title: Klondike Solitaire
summary: Klondike solitaire: draw one or three, Standard or Vegas scoring.
description: Played by touch or keyboard. Unlimited undo and redo, hints, optional automatic safe moves, a warning when no move is left, numbered deals that are the same on every board and an option for winnable deals proven by a built-in solver. Statistics per variation and the game in progress are kept on the board. No network. Needs a screen of at least 640x480 (portrait 480x640 in PDA mode).
